description:
The unused `_command` parameter is removed from the JSON output constructors and every site that passes it.

## Background

`JsonOutput::success` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`) and `JsonError::new` accept an unused `_command: impl Into<String>` parameter kept for API compatibility. This is a greenfield repository where that compatibility is not required, so the parameter is stale ceremony. The output macros in `crates/jit/src/output_macros.rs` thread a `$command` argument into those constructors, and the constructors are also called directly, so removing the parameter also removes the macro argument and updates the invocation sites across the command layer and `main.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `_command` parameter is removed from `JsonOutput::success` and `JsonError::new`, and the output macros no longer take or forward a command argument.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every call site that passed a command argument is updated, and the JSON output types build and produce identical output.

## Notes

The change is output-preserving: only the removed parameter and its arguments change, not the emitted JSON.
title: Remove the dead _command output parameter
